Name: daily luck for fishing
Author: suHuayun
Description:
In order to create a special purpose for daily luck that is not affected by luck skills, a purpose related to fishing difficulty and speed has been added to daily luck, which is only affected by fishing skills and not by luck skills.

为了给每日运气创造不受运气技能影响的特殊用途，给每日运气添加了一个与钓鱼难度和速度挂钩的用途，该用途仅收钓鱼技能影响，不受运气技能影响。

On the contrary, negative daily runs will shorten the fishing rod and slow down the hooking speed of fish, while higher fishing skills will weaken the impact of this part.

相反地，负的每日运行将缩短钓鱼条，减慢鱼的上钩速度，而更高的钓鱼技能将削弱这一部分的影响。

More uses related to daily luck will be released in the future.
今后将发布更多与每日运气有关的用途。
